observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black rechargeable standing fan with a round base and a tilting head.
The fan has a plastic blade set (5 blades) and a wire safety cage.
A control panel with buttons and a small display is mounted on the neck of the fan.
A power cord is visible coiled near the base in photo 1, suggesting it charges via a cable.
Watermarks from a listing site ('STORE') overlay parts of the fan body, obscuring some text on the control panel.
No clear brand or model text is legible on the fan body or control panel in either photo.
No visible cracks, missing blades, or obvious physical damage in the photos, but image resolution is limited.

claims.evidence: No 'Qasa' branding is legible in photo 0 or photo 1; the panel text is obscured by watermark and too small to confirm.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer on low
claims.evidence: No video or runtime demonstration provided; battery performance cannot be judged from static photos.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded and not hold claimed charge duration
risks.proof: A video clip showing the fan running unplugged on a timer, or a screenshot of a battery health indicator if the fan has one
risks.if_unproven: priced as if battery holds minimal or no charge (worst case, charge-cable-only use)

risks.risk: Motor or blade function issue not visible in static photos
risks.proof: A short video clip of the fan spinning at multiple speed settings
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working/motor function unverified

risks.risk: Charging port or cable damage not clearly visible
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the charging port and plug, and the adapter if separate
risks.if_unproven: priced as if charging accessory condition unknown/possibly faulty

risks.risk: Remote control (if included) may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: A photo of the remote control alongside the fan, and a clip showing it operating the fan

risks.risk: Frame/base stability or cracks not visible due to photo angle
risks.proof: A clear photo of the base and neck joint from a side angle
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural condition unknown, assume wear

proof_requests: Video clip of the fan running on battery (unplugged) at low and high speed, timed
Close-up photo of the brand/model label or control panel text, unobstructed by watermark
Photo of the charging port, cable, and adapter
Photo of the remote control if one is included
Close-up photos of the base, neck joint, and blades for cracks or repairs
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used rechargeable standing fan, and all seller claims about brand and battery life are unverifiable from the photos, so it should be priced at worst case pending further proof.
